title: Naturality of the specified scalar tensor chain map
statement: For any morphism of pairs of complexes, ordinary scalar extension of the Roos tensor morphism followed by scalarTensorChain equals scalarTensorChain followed by the target Roos tensor of the scalar-extended morphism. No goodness, completeness or boundedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; categories.tex, Tag 04VK (fully faithful localization descent).

proof.text: Apply scalarRoosTransformation to the source and target tensor tower functors, the product of the cochain scalar functors, the ordinary scalar functor and the specified scalarTensorTower. Its naturality equation is the claimed chain equation after unfolding only the tensor Roos functor and the specified chain map.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTensorChain_naturality (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    {P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ ×
      CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ} (a : P ⟶ Q) :
    ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).map a) ≫
        scalarTensorChain l E L ι W Q.1 Q.2 =
      scalarTensorChain l E L ι W P.1 P.2 ≫
        (integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l L W).map
          ((((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).map a)
